invariants.CSC-SCORE-0: Stability score computed deterministically; no RNG
invariants.CSC-READONLY-0: CSC never writes to CAE, CFI, RDP, or CAL ledgers
invariants.CSC-CHAIN-0: HMAC-SHA-256 chain on stability report ledger; broken chain halts
invariants.CSC-IMMUT-0: Stability report ledger is append-only; no record mutation
invariants.CSC-ALERT-0: SCSI below WARNING_THRESHOLD must emit alert; fail-closed
invariants.CSC-THRESHOLD-0: Stability thresholds are governed constants; not runtime-modifiable
invariants.CSC-SCOPE-0: CSC reads only constitution_snapshot.json + amendment ledger; no ext I/O
invariants.CSC-AUDIT-0: Every stability computation cycle writes a signed audit record
invariants.CSC-HUMAN0-0: SCSI < CRITICAL_THRESHOLD sets human0_escalation=True in alert
